turns.answer:
استانداردهای ISO مربوط به فلنج‌های چدن شامل موارد زیر است:

1. **ISO 7-1**: Pipe threads where pressure-tight joints are made on the threads -- Part 1: Dimensions, tolerances and designation [Document 16 - v4-1396 - تاسیسات بهداشتی-21f175e5280a, Section page-231, Page 231]
2. **ISO 49**: Malleable cast iron fittings threaded to ISO 7-1 [Document 16 - v4-1396 - تاسیسات بهداشتی-21f175e5280a, Section page-231, Page 231]
3. **ISO 65**: Carbon steel tubes suitable for screwing in accordance with ISO 7-1 [Document 16 - v4-1396 - تاسیسات بهداشتی-21f175e5280a, Section page-231, Page 231]
4. **ISO 727-1**: Fittings made from unplasticized poly(vinyl chloride) (PVC-U), chlorinated poly(vinyl chloride) (PVC-C) or acrylonitrile/butadiene/styrene (ABS) with plain sockets for pipes under pressure [Document 16 - v4-1396 - تاسیسات بهداشتی-21f175e5280a, Section page-231, Page 231]
5. **ISO 1452**: Plastics piping systems for water supply and for buried and above-ground drainage and sewerage under pressure -- Unplasticized poly(vinyl chloride) (PVC-U) [Document 16 - v4-1396 - تاسیسات بهداشتی-21f175e5280a, Section page-231, Page 231]
6. **ISO 2016**: Capillary solder fittings for copper tubes - Assembly dimensions and tests [Document 16 - v4-1396 - تاسیسات بهداشتی-21f175e5280a, Section page-231, Page 231]
7. **ISO 3633**: Plastics piping systems for soil and waste discharge (low and high temperature) inside buildings - Unplasticized poly(vinyl chloride) (PVC-U) [Document 16 - v4-1396 - تاسیسات بهداشتی-21f175e5280a, Section page-231, Page 231]
8. **ISO 4065**: Thermoplastics pipes -- Universal wall thickness table [Document 16 - v4-1396 - تاسیسات بهداشتی-21f175e5280a, Section page-231, Page 231]
9. **ISO 4145**: Non-alloy steel fittings threaded to ISO 7-1 [Document 16 - v4-1396 - تاسیسات بهداشتی-21f175e5280a, Section page-231, Page 231]
10. **ISO 4200**: Plain end steel tubes, welded and seamless -- General tables of dimensions and masses per unit length [Document 16 - v4-1396 - تاسیسات بهداشتی-21f175e5280a, Section page-231, Page 231]
11. **ISO 5752**: Metal valves [Document 16 - v4-1396 - تاسیسات بهداشتی-21f175e5280a, Section page-231, Page 231]
12. **ISO 7005-1**: Pipe flanges, Part 1: Steel flanges for industrial and general service piping systems [Document 16 - v4-1396 - تاسیسات بهداشتی-21f175e5280a, Section page-232, Page 232]
13. **ISO 7005-2**: Pipe flanges, Part 2: Cast iron flanges [Document 16 - v4-1396 - تاسیسات بهداشتی-21f175e5280a, Section page-232, Page 232]
